capabilities: display a floating table of contents over the current note
indicate the active heading position while scrolling
search headings and jump to the selected section
collapse and expand headings in the outline
customize appearance and reveal behavior via settings
extras: Available in the Obsidian Community plugins collection; supports hotkey binding for its toggle command.
problem: Obsidian's built-in outline requires switching panes, so there is no quick, in-note way to see and jump between a note's sections while editing.

relations.evidence: Rich personalization: Customize colors, layout, and more using the Style Settings plugin.

summary: Floating table-of-contents plugin that shows a GitHub-style, customizable outline overlay for navigating headings within the current note.
